diagnostics.name: missing-sequential-domain
diagnostics.message: sequential state has no resolved ClockDomain
diagnostics.suggestion: bind a root domain or instantiate the reusable module inside a domain

diagnostics.name: direct-asynchronous-sampling
diagnostics.message: a value crosses into unrelated destination state without a semantic CDC primitive
diagnostics.suggestion: use the matching Cdc.sync, gray, pulse, handshake, fifo, or reported waiver form

diagnostics.name: multi-bit-level-synchronizer
diagnostics.message: Cdc.sync accepts only a one-bit Bool level
diagnostics.suggestion: use Cdc.gray, Cdc.handshake, or Cdc.fifo according to coherence requirements

diagnostics.name: pulse-through-level-synchronizer
diagnostics.message: a Pulse cannot use the one-bit level synchronizer
diagnostics.suggestion: use Cdc.pulse so toggle, acknowledgement, and destination reconstruction remain explicit

diagnostics.name: unreported-clock-relationship-assumption
diagnostics.message: clock relationship safety was assumed without a source-located declaration or transfer primitive
diagnostics.suggestion: declare ClockRelation evidence or use a semantic crossing primitive

diagnostics.name: unsynchronized-reset-release
diagnostics.message: asynchronous reset deassertion is not synchronized for the destination domain
diagnostics.suggestion: use AsyncAssertSyncRelease or Rdc.sync with the destination and stage count

diagnostics.name: reset-reconvergence-hazard
diagnostics.message: reset paths with different assertion or release provenance reconverge unsafely
diagnostics.suggestion: use an explicit ResetController and preserve one analyzed release path per destination

diagnostics.name: boolean-used-as-clock
diagnostics.message: Bool is not Clock and cannot bind a ClockDomain clock input
diagnostics.suggestion: declare a typed Clock input or use an explicit generated, gated, or muxed domain primitive

diagnostics.name: ordinary-always-removed
diagnostics.message: always(event) is not part of the v0.2 ordinary synchronous API
diagnostics.suggestion: declare Reg or RegNext state under a ClockDomain and update it with when/elsewhen/otherwise

diagnostics.name: lowlevel-process-misuse
diagnostics.message: nodal.lowlevel.process cannot create untracked ordinary state or bypass CDC/RDC checks
diagnostics.suggestion: use domain-owned Reg state or isolate only the irreducible event-driven operation

diagnostics.name: multiple-state-drivers
diagnostics.message: state has unrelated update roots instead of one deterministic lexical priority chain
diagnostics.suggestion: combine updates into one when/elsewhen/otherwise chain or define an explicit arbitration policy
